description: Hand-written evaluation set for similar-case search and triage (no tuning data). Fictional Bydgoszcz City Hall requests, no personal data. Questions are already in the extracted, self-contained form produced by RequestAnalyzer, so the evaluation measures search + triage only (no LLM calls).

labels.duplicate: same request reworded; expected DUPLICATE of `duplicate_of`
labels.duplicate_new_period: same data asked for a newer period; expected DUPLICATE of `duplicate_of` (reply reused, values flagged)
labels.partial: one question repeats an archived case, another one is new; expected the case in similar_cases, NOT DUPLICATE
labels.related: same subject area but different information; the archived case is useful to see (soft expectation), NOT DUPLICATE
labels.unrelated: topic not in the archive (often outside City Hall); expected no similar case
labels.hard_negative: shares a street, venue, institution or keyword with an archived case but asks for something else; expected no similar case
